question: On what basis is the skin identified as the outer cremation ground?
premises: The skin has the nature of devouring time.
The cremation ground designation applies outwardly.
An outer locus is distinguished from the inner one.
inference: Because of its time-devouring nature, the skin is the cremation ground outside.
plain_english: Because of its nature of devouring time, the skin is indeed the cremation ground on the outside.
